My dear Madam
Pray thank [Mrs Codrington](/person/2294)[^1] very much for her kind present of [Mota](/place/150) photographs I did not possess any of them before, though I have some of Norfolk island and Florida[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: This present was no doubt given in connection with CMY\'s work on the [Life of John Coleridge Patteson](/book/102), with whom these places were associated.

Mrs Codrington was probably a relation (perhaps the mother) of the Rev.

Robert Henry Codrington (1830-1922), who succeeded Bishop Patteson as head of the Melanesian mission in 1871.
